snippet.title: First Look into the Indie Horror Game False God
snippet.description:
New Indie Horror Game: False God - Xiaofanchuan Games - DevLog 1

A First Look

Welcome to our first DevLog. We are pleased you have found our little studio. Xiaofanchuan Games is an indie studio creating unique horror experiences. In this game, we blend Chinese folklore and Lovecraftian cosmic horror in a first person survival horror game. This is a first look at our new game. If you’re interested in what we’re making, please follow our social media to get our latest updates.

Official Site: https://www.falsegodgame.com/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/xiaofanchuangames/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@xiaofanchuangames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/xfchuangames
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/xiaofanchuangames
